stories.title: Tesla's new Roadster does a kickflip over a Semi
stories.summary: At the Roadster unveiling at SpaceX's test site in McGregor, Texas, Tesla's new car, with no one inside, drove up a curved ramp until it hung upside down, then used SpaceX-built thrusters to jump and barrel-roll over a Model 3, Model Y, Cybertruck, Cybercab and Semi before landing on its wheels. Tesla's "Do a kickflip!" clip got 206K likes, and the joke of the night was "we got flying cars before GTA 6," since Rockstar had released the GTA 6 launch trailer that morning. Even the White House posted it, over a Vice City-style picture of Trump and a flying car. Production is planned for 2028.
